rubric.description: Declares a constructor named Dog with two String parameters (name and breed)
Calls super(name) as the first statement, passing the name parameter to the superclass constructor
Correctly assigns the breed parameter to the breed field
Declares getArea with the correct matching signature (public double getArea()), overriding the superclass method
Correctly computes the area using Math.PI * radius * radius
Uses a loop that traverses every element of shapes
Calls getArea() on each Shape element, relying on polymorphism/dynamic dispatch to invoke the correct subclass's implementation
Correctly accumulates and returns the total area
